BiblicalUsage: Around the throne there is a rainbow in sight like unto an emerald, the green stone shining round the One who sits there. The word names the emerald itself, the colour of the rainbow John saw.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the green rainbow around the throne says mercy surrounds judgment, and the God who judges is the God who keeps His promise.
